Review Title: The best I have tried for directing the solids away from my stoma! Very easy to empty bag now 😁!
Review: I had been having trouble with the output staying around where it comes out preventing further pieces from getting past the one sometimes more, lodged around the stoma. I had tried several brands that did nothing but turn everything brown and liquid at the neck where we open to entry. But they did nothing for the new stuff up top of the bag, causing what I’ve now figured out that’s what seasoned Ostomates call “pancaking”. Plus, this also seems to keep the stoma from sucking the plastic bag into it, also blocking the pathway for subsequent output. I can still smell the poop ONLY when I empty into the toilet and it doesn’t smell as strong anymore. My husband has never been able to smell it but he doesn’t have the “Blood Hound” smeller I do-thank God! And it’s just the two of us living in our house. My biggest problem was the difficulty getting the stuff out of the bag, especially when I start to back up and have to use something like Miralax. That makes it really sticky and almost impossible for me to shake it out, usually having to dig way up into the mess and pull it out! So disgusting and embarrassing when my husband has to help me pour water into the top of the bag to wash it out! I have decided to just throw the whole bag away when it gets like that! But this product helps with that too. And like I said it’s the best brand for the money I have found. Good luck and may God give peace to all who have to deal with this!
